stop_rule: spec v15 execution.barrier: "non-certified evaluations recorded with cause; in A1-A3 a run of barrier points in a region stops for review". Operational form frozen by Planner task W15: after every wave, STOP (launch no further wave) if (a) 2 or more non-certified points fall in ONE region (node+duration ladder, see _region_key) or (b) 3 or more non-certified points occur overall. A single isolated non-certified point does NOT stop the campaign: it is recorded as a barrier point with its cause. Points already running always finish; unlaunched points are recorded as not_launched_stop_rule and campaign_results.json carries STOP_FOR_REVIEW true (exit 3).
launch_plan: waves of 7 points in spec order; the stop rule is evaluated after each wave (the harness's evaluate() has no stop hook, so the wave is the unit at which the campaign can stop)
stage: P5.15 Addendum 27 Phase A, A2 -- the presence design of the best per-node settings (4 new) and the lattice C* (1): 5 points; staging not available
authority: P5_15_S45_REVERIFY_RULING.md (oracle re-verified; consequence 2: bar on the gross cost step, fixed by W5)
Planner task W15: stages a1a/a1b/a2/a3, the operational stop rule, the selection rules as code

objective_convention: F uses gross; salvage reported separately. Q(x) = certified_cost = gross_operational_cost (settlement-excluded); F(x) = I(x) + Q(x); terminal_salvage_value and net_operational_recourse = gross - salvage are reported, excluded from F (Addendum 27 item 3).
budget_convention: budget_slack_eur = B - I(x) at B = 1e+06 EUR, REPORTED only; the budget is NOT applied in Phase A (spec v15 master_constraints.budget: "applied from Phase B only; A1 runs without it by construction")

bar.definition: max over the last 10 cycles of |gross_operational_cost[k] - gross_operational_cost[k-1]| (settlement-excluded gross cost; the predecessor of the first window row is taken from the full trajectory; a step is unavailable when cycle k-1 is absent or either gross value is None)

rule_ten.note: production ratio = the net-recourse step the stopping test used / its tolerance; the gross version is computed here from the per-cycle record (terminal row vs its predecessor)

record.units: bytes on macOS/BSD, kilobytes on Linux (ru_maxrss)
record.semantics: child_python_process = RUSAGE_SELF of the evaluation process at record time (the evaluation's own peak); production_state = the same measure taken by production at the end of run_operational_planning; solver_subprocesses = RUSAGE_CHILDREN max over the IPOPT executables this evaluation launched; when a post-certification step ran, child_python_process includes it (the ADMM run alone is production_state)

points_provenance.rule: spec v15 A2: "the best single-node setting per node combined in a 2^|N| presence design (4 new points) ... C* rounded to the lattice (1.0 MVA / 4.0 MWh at all nodes) - 1 point". The 4 new points are the subsets with at least two nodes: the empty set is A0's x0 and the three singletons are a1a points.

evidence.rule: A2 best setting for node 5 = argmin F within node 5's a1a ladder; ties -> lower I(x)
A2 best setting for node 7 = argmin F within node 7's a1a ladder; ties -> lower I(x)
A2 best setting for node 9 = argmin F within node 9's a1a ladder; ties -> lower I(x)

points_provenance.staging: STAGING IS NOT AVAILABLE in this campaign: the canonical candidate form carries exactly ONE investment year (p515_s44_campaign_harness.canonical_candidate; multi-cohort candidates were explicitly out of scope of the year support added by W14, 85c147fa). Spec v15 A2 names 2 staging points ("half the best capacity in y1 plus half in y2" and "the full capacity in y2 alone"); the first needs two cohorts at one node and cannot be specified here, and neither is included in stage a2. A staged point is REFUSED rather than mis-specified as a single-cohort point.
staging_points_in_spec_v15_not_included: half the best capacity in y1 + half in y2 (two cohorts)
the full best capacity in y2 alone
points_provenance.lattice_c_star: 1.0 MVA / 4.0 MWh at nodes 5, 7, 9, investment year 2025

memory_preflight_at_run.vm_stat_header: Mach Virtual Memory Statistics: (page size of 16384 bytes)
memory_preflight_at_run.rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied) x page size >= 7 x 2.75 GiB
memory_preflight_at_run.rule_rationale: non-reclaimable load = wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied pages; file-backed pages (active or inactive) are cache the kernel reclaims on demand, so free + inactive under-counts what new processes can obtain (free + inactive recorded alongside)

memory_rule_vs_a0_spec.a0_rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied) x page size >= 7 x 2.75 GiB
memory_rule_vs_a0_spec.rule: hw.memsize - (wired + anonymous + compressor-occupied) x page size >= 7 x 2.75 GiB
